data.name: FigmaBasics.FramesinFi
data.value: Frames in Figma are what you may think of as artboards in other design tools. Frames are a foundational element for your designs that act as a top-level container for most things you create in Figma. There are a few different ways to create frames in Figma:

data.name: FigmaBasics.CustomSizes.Customsize
data.value: Custom sizes\nCreate custom sized frames by selecting the frame tool and click and drag your cursor to the desired size.

data.name: FigmaBasics.PresetSizes.Presetsize
data.value: Preset sizes\nCreate frames with preset sizes, e.g. iPhone X, by selecting the preset in the Properties panel on the right-hand side.

data.name: FigmaBasics.ExistingElements.Existingel
data.value: Existing elements\nCreate frames from existing elements on the canvas by right-clicking and selecting Frame Selection.

data.name: FigmaBasics.SelecttheFrameTool
data.value: Select the Frame Tool and click and drag along the dotted line to create a new frame.
